title: A1.2 — Past Tenses, Present Perfect, & Daily Life
description: Talk about your past experiences, daily routines, and handle everyday situations like shopping, dining, and describing the weather.

themes.title: Daily Routines
themes.description: Describe your daily schedule using reflexive verbs and time expressions.

themes.title: Food & Shopping
themes.description: Navigate a supermarket, order food, and talk about meals and prices.

themes.title: Weather & Health
themes.description: Describe the weather, talk about illnesses, and visit the doctor.

themes.title: Time & Calendar
themes.description: Tell time, name days and months, and express when things happened using 'hace' and time words.

themes.title: Preterite — Regular Verbs
themes.description: Master regular preterite conjugations for -AR, -ER, and -IR verbs to tell stories about the past.

themes.title: Preterite — Irregular Verbs
themes.description: Learn the high-frequency irregular preterite verbs: ESTAR, IR, HACER, TENER, and DECIR.

themes.title: Present Perfect
themes.description: Use HABER + past participles to talk about recent experiences and actions with present relevance.

themes.title: Demonstratives & Possessives
themes.description: Point to things at different distances and express ownership with demonstrative and possessive adjectives.
